{
  "intent": "vote_and_position",
  "vote": "yes",
  "position": "reduce",
  "chosen_strategy": "vote for emission cut, then exit 75% of farm position over first 3 days while absorbing treasury stabilization bid, keep 25% as call option on retained farmer supply reduction",
  "expected_12d_price_change_pct": -18.5,
  "reasoning": "Baseline net sell pressure is 30k YLD/day (farmers selling rewards) vs 50k emissions, so 20k YLD/day accumulates or is absorbed. At $2.40, 30k YLD/day is $72k/day sell pressure against $800k liquidity; naive liquidity absorption is ~11 days at current pace, but price already fell 25% in 14 days, showing liquidity is thin. If cut fails: 38% of 50k = 19k YLD/day strategic farmers leave, but they likely dump positions on exit; assume 50% of their farmed rewards (19k) are sold over 3 days plus position unwind of ~$38k (38% of $100k TVL proportional share of $45M TVL is rough, but simpler: they control 38% of emissions, so their exit removes buy demand and adds sell). Net effect if cut fails: emissions stay 50k, morale collapse, price likely drops another 20-25%. If cut passes: emissions drop to 25k/day. Retained farmers sell fewer rewards; assume sell pressure drops from 30k to 15k YLD/day. But delayed-unlock cohort adds 4k/day for 3 days, so days 1-3 net sell pressure is ~19k/day vs 25k emissions, meaning 6k/day net supply reduction. Treasury stabilization order of $40k absorbs ~16.7k YLD at $2.40, providing a temporary bid. However, $800k liquidity is tiny relative to $45M TVL and ongoing emissions; even with cut, 25k YLD/day at $2.40 is $60k/day, or $720k over 12 days, nearly exhausting liquidity if not offset by demand. Price should stabilize somewhat but still drift lower due to thin liquidity. Expected 12-day price change: baseline drift -10% from continued supply, plus -5% from thin liquidity stress, partially offset by +2% from treasury bid and reduced emissions, net -18.5%. Strategy: vote yes to avoid worse -25% scenario, but don't stay fully exposed; exit 75% into stables during treasury bid window (first 1-3 days) to capture best execution, keep 25% for upside if retained farmers actually hold and price recovers after day 3 when delayed unlocks end."
